data.name: Query_DataForDispatch_DashBoard_Shiekhoo
data.value:
Select max(OnDate) as OnDate ,sum(ToDate) as ToDate,CompanyID,PeriodID,DocumentTypeID from ( Select isnull((Select ABS(Tab.OnDate) as OnDate From ( ( Select Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as OnDate , INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID from [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_ContractDetail] ON [SAL_ContractDetail].[ContractDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[ContractDetailID] AND [SAL_ContractDetail].[ContractID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].ContractHeaderID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_ContractDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_ContractDetail].[Status] = 1 inner join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = [SAL_ContractDetail].CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = [SAL_ContractDetail].PeriodID Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID IN (Select DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where MenuID =(Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath ='/Sales/Dispatch_New_frm.aspx' ) And DocumentType like '%@DocType' And Status=1 and COmpanyID IN @CompanyID) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate = CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID IN @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 {0} Group By INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID) )Tab ),0) as OnDate, ABS(Sum(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity))as ToDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID,
INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID from [SAL_DispatchHeader] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 And Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 left join SAL_ContractDetail On SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID --And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID left Join SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID AND SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1 Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID IN @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID IN (Select DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where MenuID =(Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu Where MenuPath ='/Sales/Dispatch_New_frm.aspx' ) And DocumentType like '%@DocType' And Status=1 and COmpanyID IN @CompanyID) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.status=1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.status=1 AND SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 {0} Group By INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ) as tab group by CompanyID,PeriodID,DocumentTypeID

data.name: Query_GetDocNoForGateIN
data.value:
Select SAL_GateIn.GateInNo as DocumentNo, SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID ,SAL_GateIn.VehicleNo, SAL_GateIn.DriverName ,SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID , SAL_VehicleCancellation.DocumentNo as CancelDocNo from SAL_GateIn left join SAL_VehicleCancellation on SAL_VehicleCancellation.DocumentNo = SAL_GateIn.GateInNo and SAL_VehicleCancellation.DocumentTypeID = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID and SAL_VehicleCancellation.CompanyID= SAL_GateIn.CompanyID and SAL_VehicleCancellation.PeriodID= SAL_GateIn.PeriodID and SAL_VehicleCancellation.DocumentNo is null And SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Inner JOin SET_DocumentType Inv_Doc on Inv_Doc.DocumentTypeID = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID AND Inv_Doc.CompanyID = SAL_GateIn.CompanyID AND Inv_Doc.PeriodID= SAL_GateIn.PeriodID AND Inv_Doc.Status = 1 {0} {1} and SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_GateIn.GateInNo not in ( Select distinct SAL_GateIn.GateInNo as DocumentNo --,SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID -- ,SAL_GateIn.VehicleNo, SAL_GateIn.DriverName from SAL_GateIn Inner JOin SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_GateIn.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID= SAL_GateIn.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 And SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
left JOin INV_FirstWeight on INV_FirstWeight.GateINID = SAL_GateIn.GateInNo AND INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID AND INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = SAL_GateIn.CompanyID AND INV_FirstWeight.PeriodID = SAL_GateIn.PeriodID AND INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID
AND INV_FirstWeight.Status = 1
left Join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentNo AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID = INV_FirstWeight.PeriodID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.Status = 1 left Join INV_SecondWeight on INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo AND INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID AND INV_SecondWeight.PeriodId = INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodId AND INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID AND INV_SecondWeight.Status = 1
inner join (Select INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo as DispatchNO,Lower(RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(DocumentType,CHARINDEX('-',DocumentType)+1,LEN(DocumentType)))))as NameType ,Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID from INV_StockTransactionHeader inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID --AND Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 left Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentType Inv_Doc ON Inv_Doc.COMPANYID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Inv_Doc.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID {0} --where Inv_Doc.DocumentType like '%Sugar' group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, DocumentType,Inv_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID ) abc on abc.CompanyID = INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID and abc.PeriodID = INV_SecondWeight.PeriodID and abc.GrossWeightID = INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo and abc.FiscalID = SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID and abc.NameType = Lower(RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(DocumentType,CHARINDEX('-',DocumentType)+1,LEN(DocumentType))))) )

data.name: Query_Select
data.value:
Select DocumentType,SAL_GateIn.CustomerName,SAL_GateIn.VehicleNo,BiltyNo,BiltyAddress,INV_SecondWeight.GrossWeight,INV_FirstWeight.TareWeight, INV_SecondWeight.NetWeight,SAL_GateIn.TransporterID,INV_LoadingPointDetail.ItemID,INV_LoadingPointDetail.LocationID ,INV_LoadingPointDetail.RackID,INV_LoadingPointDetail.TransactionQuantity ,RackName,LocationName,INV_Item.Description,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID DelieveryOrderID,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo ,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerID,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.BrokerID,AR_SET_Customer.CityID,AR_SET_Customer.CountryID ,DriverName,SAL_GateIn.CNICNO from INV_SecondWeight
inner join SET_DocumentType on INV_SecondWeight.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID
inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo = INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo and INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID
inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID
inner join INV_FirstWeight on INV_FirstWeight.DocumentNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo and INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID and INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID
inner join SAL_GateIn on SAL_GateIn.GateInNo = INV_FirstWeight.GateINID and SAL_GateIn.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID and SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType
inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.DODetailID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID
inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerID
inner join SET_Rack on SET_Rack.RackID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.RackID inner join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.LocationID inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.ITemID
where INV_SecondWeight.Status = 1 and INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_SecondWeight.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and GateInNo not in (Select DocumentNo from SAL_VehicleCancellation where DocumentTypeID = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID and FiscalID = SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID ) and INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo = @DocumentNo

Select SAL_Token.VehicleNo , SAL_Token.BiltyNo , SAL_Token.BiltyAddress , SAL_SecondWeight.FirstWeight as TareWeight , SAL_SecondWeight.NetWeight , SAL_SecondWeight.SecondWeight as GrossWeight, SAL_Token.TransporterID ,SAL_Token.DocumentTypeID as TokenTypeID from SAL_SecondWeight

where SAL_SecondWeight.Status = 1 and SAL_SecondWeight.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_SecondWeight.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and SAL_Token.SaleTokenNo = @DocumentNo

data.value: SELECT SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID, SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID, SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID, SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID, SAL_ContractDetail.SerialNo, SAL_ContractDetail.ItemCategoryID, SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID, SAL_ContractDetail.ProductLine, SAL_ContractDetail.ItemUnitID, SAL_ContractDetail.ItemUnitQuantity, SAL_ContractDetail.ItemQuality, SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity, SAL_ContractDetail.ColorID, SAL_ContractDetail.BaseAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.Rate, SAL_ContractDetail.GrossAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.IsSalesTaxExempted, SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxFixRate, SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxPercent, SAL_ContractDetail.IsExciseDutyExempted, SAL_ContractDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.IsFEDExempted, SAL_ContractDetail.FEDAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.VATAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.GodownCharges, SAL_ContractDetail.NetAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.Status, SAL_ContractDetail.CreatedBy, SAL_ContractDetail.CreateDate, SAL_ContractDetail.CreatedByValue, SAL_ContractDetail.UpdatedBy, SAL_ContractDetail.UpdateDate, SAL_ContractDetail.UpdatedByValue, SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.Description, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, inv_item.UnitWeight, ISNULL(INV_item.UnitVolume, 1) as UnitVolume, ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS ListPricePerUnit, VolumeCode.UOMName as VolumeCodeName, ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity, 0) - (ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.ReversedQuantity, 0)) - ISNULL( ( select SUM(SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity) - isnull(sum(SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ReversedQty), 0) from SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader DO_hdr on DO_hdr.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and DO_hdr.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and DO_hdr.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID where ContractHeaderID = @OrderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID --AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and DO_hdr.StatusCode <> 15 AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 ), 0) as RemainingQTY, ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity, 0) - (ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.ReversedQuantity, 0)) - ISNULL( ( select SUM(SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity) - isnull(sum(SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ReversedQty), 0) from SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader DO_hdr on DO_hdr.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and DO_hdr.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and DO_hdr.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID where ContractHeaderID = @OrderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID --AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and DO_hdr.StatusCode <> 15 AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 ), 0) as ValidateQuantity, ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity, 0) - (ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.ReversedQuantity, 0)) - ISNULL( ( select SUM(SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity) - isnull(sum(SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ReversedQty), 0) from SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader DO_hdr on DO_hdr.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and DO_hdr.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and DO_hdr.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID where ContractHeaderID = @OrderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID --AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and DO_hdr.StatusCode <> 15 AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 ), 0) as DOQTY, ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate, 0) * CAST((Case when SAL_ContractDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when SAL_ContractDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_ContractDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end) as decimal) * (ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity, 0) - (ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.ReversedQuantity, 0)) - ISNULL( ( select SUM(SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity) from SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader DO_hdr on DO_hdr.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and DO_hdr.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and DO_hdr.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID where ContractHeaderID = @OrderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [SAL_ContractDetail].[CompanyID] and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [SAL_ContractDetail].[PeriodID] --AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and DO_hdr.StatusCode <> 15 AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 ), 0)) AS TotalAmount, '' [Action] FROM [SAL_ContractDetail] INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_ContractDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_ContractDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_ContractDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_ContractDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_ContractDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 LEFT join [SET_UnitofMeasure] as VolumeCode on [VolumeCode].[UOMID] = [inv_item].[VolumeUOMCode] WHERE [SAL_ContractDetail].[ContractID] = @OrderID and [SAL_ContractDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [SAL_ContractDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID and [SAL_ContractDetail].[Status] = 1 and (ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity, 0) - (ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.ReversedQuantity, 0)) - ISNULL( ( select SUM(SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity) - isnull(sum(SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ReversedQty), 0) from SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader DO_hdr on DO_hdr.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and DO_hdr.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and DO_hdr.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID where ContractHeaderID = @OrderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID --AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and DO_hdr.StatusCode <> 15 AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 ), 0)<>0) ORDER BY [SAL_ContractDetail].[SerialNo]

data.name: Query_Select_By_OrderID_CompanyId_PeriodIdSOS
data.value:
SELECT [SAL_ContractDetail].[ContractDetailID], --[SET_Color].[ColorName], [SAL_ContractDetail].[ContractID], [SAL_ContractDetail].[CompanyID], [SAL_ContractDetail].[PeriodID], [SAL_ContractDetail].[SerialNo], [SAL_ContractDetail].BatchId, Set_Batch.[Description], [SAL_ContractDetail].[ItemCategoryID], [SAL_ContractDetail].[ItemID],[SAL_ContractDetail].[ProductLine], [SAL_ContractDetail].[ItemUnitID], [SAL_ContractDetail].[ItemUnitQuantity], [SAL_ContractDetail].[ItemQuality], [SAL_ContractDetail].[Quantity], [SAL_ContractDetail].[ColorID], [SAL_ContractDetail].[BaseAmount], [SAL_ContractDetail].[Rate], [SAL_ContractDetail].[GrossAmount], [SAL_ContractDetail].[IsSalesTaxExempted], [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount], [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxFixRate], [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxPercent], [SAL_ContractDetail].[IsExciseDutyExempted], [SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount], [SAL_ContractDetail].[IsFEDExempted], [SAL_ContractDetail].[FEDAmount], [SAL_ContractDetail].[VATAmount], [SAL_ContractDetail].[GodownCharges], [SAL_ContractDetail].[NetAmount], [SAL_ContractDetail].[Status], [SAL_ContractDetail].[CreatedBy], [SAL_ContractDetail].[CreateDate], [SAL_ContractDetail].[CreatedByValue], [SAL_ContractDetail].[UpdatedBy], [SAL_ContractDetail].[UpdateDate], [SAL_ContractDetail].[UpdatedByValue], [SAL_ContractDetail].[Inclusive], [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryName], [INV_Item].[Description], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) AS ListPricePerUnit,
ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].[Quantity], 0) - ISNULL( ( select SUM([SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Quantity) from SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail where SalesOrderHeaderID = @ContractID AND CompanyID = [SAL_ContractDetail].[CompanyID] and PeriodID = [SAL_ContractDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractDetailID ), 0) as RemainingQTY,
ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].[Quantity], 0) - ISNULL( ( select SUM([SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].Quantity) from SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail where SalesOrderHeaderID = @ContractID AND CompanyID = [SAL_ContractDetail].[CompanyID] and PeriodID = [SAL_ContractDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractDetailID ), 0) as ValidateQuantity,
